title: No CHECK constraint: sender_msg_id NOT NULL for peer messages
description: The UNIQUE INDEX on messages(chat_id, sender_msg_id) is the idempotency guard for Peer/deliver. SQLite allows multiple NULL values in UNIQUE indexes (SQL standard). If any code path stores a peer-delivered message with sender_msg_id=NULL (application bug, future refactor), the idempotency check find_by_sender_msg_id() will never match it and the UNIQUE INDEX will not prevent duplicates. Application code currently always sets it, but there is no DB-level enforcement. — Add CHECK (sender_msg_id IS NOT NULL) on the messages table column, or add a NOT NULL constraint in the column definition, in the next schema migration.
